title: Demo: one carousel, every platform
caption:
DEMO POST 🧪 — pipeline check, not a regular post.

One JSON spec in, six platforms out — same carousel, same minute:

1. Instagram (this post)
2. LinkedIn
3. Reddit (own profile)
4. Facebook page
5. Telegram group
6. Bluesky

YouTube stays skipped until the channel is phone-verified.

If you are seeing this on more than one platform at once — the bot works.
